summary_en.String: This level gives the Third Plane boss Resonance Extrapolation one additional Formation Extrapolation.

summary_zh_cn.String: 该等级为第三位面首领的回响推演额外增加一个构音推演。

summary_en.String: This level enables the released Phase 3 enhancement for the Second Plane boss.

summary_zh_cn.String: 该等级启用已发布的第二位面首领第三阶段强化。

summary_en.String: This level adds 20 Cosmic Fragments to every Blessing reset cost.

summary_zh_cn.String: 该等级使每次重置祝福的费用增加20宇宙碎片。

summary_en.String: This level removes one initial countdown, one dice reroll and 100 initial Cosmic Fragments.

summary_zh_cn.String: 该等级减少1点初始倒计时、1次重投和100初始宇宙碎片。

summary_en.String: This level grants Negative Curios whenever the party enters a plane.

summary_zh_cn.String: 该等级在队伍进入每个位面时给予负面奇物。

summary_en.String: This level reduces the effective Blessing count of every Path by one.

summary_zh_cn.String: 该等级将所有命途的有效祝福计数各减少1。
